items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: So, when, after I got with Hippolyte Charles, I was playing tenor banjo then.

ctx.x: Did you have a teacher when you took up any bass or anything or pick that up then?

Well, I did have a teacher, a white fella. He gave me a whole lot of ideas on the fingerboard of the instrument. That was a fella called Matil Fertranger. Matil Fertranger. He had a place of business right here at Cornel and Claiborne. He was crippled. And he played at the... at the Orphan Theater. And he gave it up. But he was a good musician. So he gave me the fingerboard. You know, I used to bum around these places, see. And he'd take my liking to me. So he just gave me that fingerboard of the bass and gave me…
Who else was in the band when you were there?
